topics.summary: The broadcast features chaotic segments including a dial-a-date call where a man struggles to pronounce 'O’s,’ an interview with ‘Born Against Stern’, and Fred wearing inappropriate attire, while the sound guy is blamed for silence. The host attempts to promote candy loving and People's Carnival of Addams sales amidst ongoing confusion.

topics.title: Beer, Baseball, and Radio Rambles
topics.summary: During an on-air conversation, callers discuss spilling beer, frustrations with baseball contracts, and concerns about foreign athletes. A promotional segment for Congressional Photo’s color print deals follows before transitioning to a rock music performance featuring the Budweiser World of Wheels event.

topics.title: Radio Broadcast with Listener Calls & Commercials
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, the host takes phone calls from listeners including an elderly woman discussing her granddaughter. The show then transitions to advertisements for Honda motorcycles, Mike and Ike candies, Hardy's biscuits, Evening Magazine filming segments of the program, and finally commercials for Candy Loving’s playboy centerfold.””

The hosts discuss recent television programs including 'Police Squad,' Linda Carter's upcoming street life special featuring Wonder Woman, Tony Orlando, and the U.S. Marine Corps Drill Team, alongside speculation about an unexplained cloud circling Earth.

topics.title: Glenview Rock Music Protest and Pipeline Sniffing
topics.summary: Parents in Glenview Illinois are protesting rock music’s presence in schools due to drug associations while simultaneously reports emerge of children sniffing natural gas pipelines in Longview Texas leading to police investigations.

topics.title: Dial-a-Date & Movie Producers Mishap
topics.summary: During the show, Howard interacts with Candy Loving, an aspiring actress accompanied by movie producers. They discuss religion, Howard’s image, and a potential film contract for Candy, leading to awkward conversations about her background and numerous misinterpretations among the hosts.

topics.title: Bar Mitzvah Call-In Chaos
topics.summary: A radio host attempts to guide a listener through singing his bar mitzvah song, but the segment quickly devolves into an absurd conversation filled with unsolicited advice about Jewish customs and personal relationships, culminating in bizarre commentary on callers’ lives.

topics.title: Broadcast Covers Music and Film Controversy
topics.summary: The broadcast features musical performances by blues musicians and discussions of upcoming concerts for Rubber Rodeo and Das Buit. It then transitions to a discussion about new movie releases including Quest to Fire, Diner, Evil Under the Sun alongside commentary on President Reagan’s administration's family planning clinic funding proposal.
